evidence.detail: rs/l/i stores an immutable upper bound, a current integer and a direction step initialized to +1. Each tick adds the direction, flips to -1 at the upper bound and flips back to +1 at zero.
R418 RichTextStyleParser owns exactly four instances with bounds 25, 50, 125 and 250; no unrelated exact-v308 subsystem constructs this counter type.
Client's live frame/update path ticks all four RichTextStyleParser counters once per update before advancing the other animated text-color cycle state.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the generic bounded ping-pong integer counter used by rich-text animated styles.

evidence.detail: R55 RSFont calls rs/l/k repeatedly while parsing live markup, using its return values to update text color, alpha/style state, item/icon insertion and animated formatting state.

The class recognizes and parses multiple style-tag families including pulse tags (pu1/pu2), fla/fla2 close/reset forms, numeric/hex style parameters, item= inline references and color/style closing tags.

Its parsing methods delegate to the reviewed FlashingTextEffect and other R343–R362 rich-text effect/markup classes, and resolve inline item/icon/color metadata through the recovered rich-text registry family.
The class owns four OscillatingCounter instances with bounds 25/50/125/250 plus shared animated-color state consumed during markup evaluation; Client ticks these counters in the live update loop.

The class sits exactly between R343 RichTextMarkupRegistry (rs/l/j, CLIENT_CLASS_000499) and R356 FlashingTextEffect (rs/l/l, CLIENT_CLASS_000501), fixing rs/l/k as the central style-tag parser/coordinator in that contiguous rich-text family.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the central static rich-text style/tag parser used by RSFont. It does not replace the separate RichTextMarkupRegistry or individual effect classes.
